arxiv-2011-10494.title: A Mathematical Model For the Spread of a Virus
arxiv-2011-10494.creator: N. R. Sheeley, Jr
arxiv-2011-10494.description: Abstract This paper describes a mathematical model for the spread of a virus through an isolated population of a given size. The model uses three, color-coded components, called molecules (red for infected and still contagious, green for infected, but no longer contagious, and blue for uninfected).

arxiv-2108-01785.title: Weakly Supervised Foreground Learning for Weakly Supervised Localization and Detection
arxiv-2108-01785.creator: Chenlin Zhang, Yin Li, Jianxin Wu
arxiv-2108-01785.description: Abstract Modern deep learning models require large amounts of accurately annotated data, which is often difficult to satisfy. Hence, weakly supervised tasks, including weakly supervised object localization (WSOL) and detection (WSOD), have recently received attention in the computer vision community.

arxiv-2208-05728.title: Continual Transfer Learning for Cross-Domain Click-Through Rate Prediction at Taobao Conference: Companion Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2023; April 30-May 4, 2023; Austin, TX, USA Companion Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2023 (WWW ’23 Companion), April 30-May 4, 2023, Austin, TX, USA
arxiv-2208-05728.creator: Lixin Liu, Yanling Wang, Tianming Wang, Dong Guan, Jiawei Wu, Jingxu Chen, Rong Xiao, Wenxiang Zhu, Fei Fang
arxiv-2208-05728.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Lixin Liu, Yanling Wang, Tianming Wang, Dong Guan, Jiawei Wu, Jingxu Chen, Rong Xiao, Wenxiang Zhu, Fei Fang. We study the problem of cross-domain click-through rate (CTR) prediction for recommendation at Taobao. Cross-domain CTR prediction has been widely studied in recent years, while most attempts ignore the continual learning setting in industrial recommender systems. In light of this, we present a necessary but less-studied problem named Continual Transfer Learning (CTL), which transfers knowledge from a time-evolving source domain to a time-evolving target domain.

arxiv-2311-15663.title: Comparison between Tensor Networks and Variational Quantum Classifier
arxiv-2311-15663.creator: G. Laskaris, Ar. A. Melnikov, M. R. Perelshtein, R. Brasher, F. Neukart, T. Bäck
arxiv-2311-15663.description: Abstract The primary objective of this paper is to conduct a comparative analysis between two Machine Learning approaches: Tensor Networks (TN) and Variational Quantum Classifiers (VQC). While both approaches share similarities in their representation of the Hilbert space using a logarithmic number of parameters, they diverge in the manifolds they cover.

arxiv-2410-07323.title: Hybrid SO(10) Axion Model Without Quality Problem
arxiv-2410-07323.creator: K.S. Babu 1 , Bhaskar Dutta 2 , and Rabindra N. Mohapatra 3
arxiv-2410-07323.description: Abstract Invisible axion models that solve the strong CP problem via the Peccei-Quinn (PQ) mechanism typically have a quality problem that arises from quantum gravity effects which violate all global symmetries. These models therefore require extreme fine-tuning of parameters for consistency.

arxiv-2508-15609.title: Sub-GeV Sterile Neutrino as a Probe of Neutrino Mass Generation in the Minimal Left-Right Symmetric Model
arxiv-2508-15609.creator: Gang Li, Ying-Ying Li, Sida Lu, Ye-Ling Zhou
arxiv-2508-15609.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gang Li, Ying-Ying Li, Sida Lu, Ye-Ling Zhou. The minimal left-right symmetric model (mLRSM) provides an elegant and testable framework for addressing the origin of neutrino masses. We examine the constraints on the sub-GeV sterile neutrino in the type-II seesaw scenario of the mLRSM without left-right mixing, taking limits from collider searches, meson decays, supernovae, neutrinoless double beta ( 0 ​ ν ​ β ​ β 0\nu\beta\beta ) decay and cosmology.

arxiv-2512-09722.title: A tree bijection for the moduli space of genus- 𝟎 \boldsymbol{0} hyperbolic surfaces with boundaries
arxiv-2512-09722.creator: Timothy Budd, Thomas Meeusen, Bart Zonneveld
arxiv-2512-09722.description: Abstract The Weil-Petersson volume of genus- g g hyperbolic surfaces with geodesic boundaries is known since work of Mirzakhani to be polynomial in the boundary lengths. We provide a bijective proof of this fact in the genus- 0 0 case in the presence of a distinguished cusp.

arxiv-2602-19972.title: Non Fermi liquid signatures across strain engineered metal-insulator transition in line-graph lattices
arxiv-2602-19972.creator: Shashikant Singh Kunwar, Madhuparna Karmakar
arxiv-2602-19972.description: Abstract Controlling the properties and thus the functionalities of correlated electron systems via externally tunable perturbations has always remained a cherished goal in quantum condensed matter physics. Recently, straintronics has proved to be one such external control which can dictate the quantum phases and transitions in materials via the reconstruction of their electronic band structure.

pmc-10703893.title: Sexually transmitted infections and associated risk factors among sexual minority women in China
pmc-10703893.creator: Xiaofang Wang, Zhaohui Ouyang, Enwu Liu, Mengjie Han
pmc-10703893.description: There is a potential for transmission of sexually transmitted infections (STIs) within sexual minority women (SMW) in China. However, research specifically focused on STIs among SMW in China is severely limited. This study aims to evaluate the prevalence of STIs and identify associated risk factors among SMW in Beijing, China.

pmc-11608476.title: Noninferiority comparison of electromagnetic navigation-guided versus computed tomography-guided percutaneous localization of multiple small pulmonary nodules: a prospective randomized clinical trial
pmc-11608476.creator: Hongliang Hui, Haoran Miao, Fan Qiu, Huaming Li, Yangui Lin, Yiqian Zhang, Bo Jiang
pmc-11608476.description: BackgroundAccurate preoperative localization is a challenge in thoracoscopic surgery for multiple pulmonary nodules. In this study, we aimed to assess the accuracy and feasibility of electromagnetic navigation (EN)-guided percutaneous localization.MethodsWe enrolled 50 patients with multiple pulmonary nodules for EN-guided (EN group) or CT-guided (CT group) localization.

pmc-11653465.title: Health Risk Assessment of Occupational Exposures of Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons, Phthalates, and Semi-Volatile Chlorinated Organic Compounds in Urine of Commercial Fish Smokers, Ghana
pmc-11653465.creator: Charity Owusu, Albert Ofori, Frank Adusei-Mensah, Joseph Kweku Adjei, George Yaw Hadzi, John Kwesi Bentum, Reginald Quansah, David K Essumang
pmc-11653465.description: Occupational exposure to smoke and polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) poses significant health risks, especially for commercial fish smokers who are regularly exposed to high levels of smoke and particulate matter. This study aimed to evaluate the exposure levels and assess the health risks associated with PAHs, phenols, phthalates, and substituted benzenes among 155 fish smokers in Ghana.

pmc-11688869.title: EXPLORING HOW INTERPERSONAL FACTORS SHAPE HEALTH BEHAVIORS AMONG HISPANIC OLDER ADULTS: A SCOPING REVIEW
pmc-11688869.creator: Barbara Mendez Campos, Karen Lyons, Bruna Lopez
pmc-11688869.description: As the U.S. experiences a significant demographic shift, particularly among older adults, this scoping review focuses on the Hispanic population, one of the largest segments of historically underrepresented racial/ethnic groups in this age cohort. An in-depth exploration of health behaviors becomes imperative with this demographic surge and an accompanying higher chronic illness profile.
